name: @bolyra/hosted-verify
description: Bolyra hosted verify endpoint — External Verifier Contract v1 over HTTP on Cloudflare Workers. Design Partner Preview: classical (Bolyra Core) verification only.

scripts.deploy: echo 'deploy: choose the target explicitly — npm run deploy:staging or npm run deploy:prod' >&2 && exit 1
scripts.deploy:staging: wrangler deploy --env staging | tee /dev/stderr | node scripts/verify-deploy.mjs https://bolyra-hosted-verify-staging.kondojuviswanadha.workers.dev --from-wrangler --env staging --tenant bolyra-staging
scripts.deploy:prod: wrangler deploy --env="" | tee /dev/stderr | node scripts/verify-deploy.mjs https://bolyra-hosted-verify.kondojuviswanadha.workers.dev --from-wrangler --env production --tenant bolyra-canary
scripts.verify:dev: bash scripts/with-worker.sh node scripts/verify-deploy.mjs --env local --tenant local --secrets-from-dev-vars
